```{r}
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/laura/Desktop/uni/Bachelor/csv.with.text.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

citation()
```

```{r}
df$string <- stri_replace_all_regex(df$string, "[^\\P{C}]+", "")  # Removes invalid control characters.

sentiment_scores <- analyzeSentiment(df$string)

df$sentimentscore <- sentiment_scores$SentimentQDAP 
df$posQDAP <-sentiment_scores$PositivityQDAP 
df$negQDAP <- sentiment_scores$NegativityQDAP

df <- df[-95, ]

df <- df %>%
  filter(phase != 9)

# Ensure section is a factor
df$section <- as.factor(df$section)

# Rename the levels
levels(df$section) <- c("before", "during", "after")

```

```{r}
#factoring phase and adding unique identifier
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(interview = paste(id, session, sep = "_"))

df$phase <- factor(df$phase, levels = 1:9)

#filtering out two interviews in a new data set
filtered_df <- df %>% 
  filter(!(interview %in% c("1_2", "3_2")))
```


```{r}
#filtering out 0 values
no_0_fil <- filtered_df %>%
     filter(!(sentimentscore == 0.00000000 & posQDAP == 0.00000000 & negQDAP == 0.00000000))

no_0_ful <- df %>%
     filter(!(sentimentscore == 0.00000000 & posQDAP == 0.00000000 & negQDAP == 0.00000000))
```


```{r}
#plotting filtered data and all data and as boxplots

ggplot(data = no_0_ful, aes(x = as.factor(section), y = sentimentscore, fill = as.factor(section))) +

```

```{r}
#checking for normality before running models
ggplot(no_0_ful, aes(x = sentimentscore)) +
  geom_density(fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of Sentiment Scores",
    x = "Sentiment Score",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

qqnorm(no_0_ful$sentimentscore, main = "Q-Q Plot of Sentiment Scores")
qqline(no_0_ful$sentimentscore, col = "red")  # Add a reference line for normal distribution
```


```{r}
#running 5 models with all interviews
formula1 <- bf(sentimentscore ~ section + (1 | id) + (1 | session))
formula2 <- bf(sentimentscore ~ section + session + (1 | id))
formula3 <- bf(sentimentscore ~ section * session + (1 | id))
formula4 <- bf(sentimentscore ~ section + (1 | id))
formula5 <- bf(sentimentscore ~ section)

model_ful1 <- brm(formula = formula1, data = no_0_ful, family = gaussian(), chains = 4, cores = 2, iter = 2000, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97))

model_ful2 <- brm(formula = formula2, data = no_0_ful, family = gaussian(), chains = 4, cores = 2, iter = 2000, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97))

model_ful3 <- brm(formula = formula3, data = no_0_ful, family = gaussian(), chains = 4, cores = 2, iter = 2000, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97))

model_ful4 <- brm(formula = formula4, data = no_0_ful, family = gaussian(), chains = 4, cores = 2, iter = 2000, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97))

model_ful5 <- brm(formula = formula5, data = no_0_ful, family = gaussian(), chains = 4, cores = 2, iter = 2000, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97))

summary(model_ful1)
summary(model_ful2)
summary(model_ful3)
summary(model_ful4)
summary(model_ful5)
plot(model_ful1)
plot(model_ful2)
plot(model_ful3)
plot(model_ful4)
plot(model_ful5)

#doing model comparison
model_ful1 <- add_criterion(model_ful1, "loo")
model_ful2 <- add_criterion(model_ful2, "loo")
model_ful3 <- add_criterion(model_ful3, "loo")
model_ful4 <- add_criterion(model_ful4, "loo")
model_ful5 <- add_criterion(model_ful5, "loo")
loo_compare(model_ful1, model_ful2, model_ful3, model_ful4, model_ful5, criterion = "loo")

plot(hypothesis(model_ful4, "Intercept + sectionduring  = Intercept + sectionafter"))

```

```{r}
#moving into topic  modeling now
#concatinating all strings
grouped_df <- df %>%
  #group_by(id, session, section, phase, string) %>%
  group_by(id, session, section, phase, experience) %>%
  #group_by(id, session, section) %>%
  summarize(combined_string = str_c(string, collapse = " "), .groups = "drop")

#investigating strings
grouped_df$combined_string[4]  # View the first row's text
```

```{r}
#loading stopwords
english_stopwords <- readLines("https://slcladal.github.io/resources/stopwords_en.txt", encoding = "UTF-8")
english_stopwords <- c(english_stopwords, "yeah")

# renaming the columns
grouped_df <- grouped_df %>%
  rename(text = combined_string)%>%
  mutate(doc_id = paste(id, session, section, phase, experience, sep = "_"))%>%
  mutate(doc_id = as.integer(as.factor(doc_id)))

grouped_df <- grouped_df %>%
  select(doc_id, everything())

grouped_df <- grouped_df %>%
  arrange(doc_id)

# creating corpus
corpus <- Corpus(DataframeSource(as.data.frame(grouped_df)))
pre_corp <- tm_map(corpus, content_transformer(tolower))
pre_corp <- tm_map(pre_corp, removeWords, english_stopwords)
pre_corp <- tm_map(pre_corp, removePunctuation, preserve_intra_word_dashes = TRUE)
pre_corp <- tm_map(pre_corp, removeNumbers)
pre_corp <- tm_map(pre_corp, stemDocument, language = "en")
pre_corp <- tm_map(pre_corp, stripWhitespace)

minimumFrequency <- 1
DTM <- DocumentTermMatrix(pre_corp, control = list(bounds = list(global = c(minimumFrequency, Inf))))

# have a look at the number of documents and terms in the matrix
dim(DTM)
```

```{r}
#removing rows maybe
sel_idx <- slam::row_sums(DTM) > 0
DTM <- DTM[sel_idx, ]
textdata <- textdata[sel_idx, ]
```

```{r}
#finding optimal number of topics
result <- ldatuning::FindTopicsNumber(
  DTM,
  topics = seq(from = 2, to = 20, by = 1),
  metrics = c("CaoJuan2009",  "Deveaud2014"),
  method = "Gibbs",
  control = list(seed = 77),
  verbose = TRUE
)

FindTopicsNumber_plot(result)
```
```{r}
# number of topics
K <- 6
# set random number generator seed
set.seed(9161)
# compute the LDA model, inference via 1000 iterations of Gibbs sampling
topicModel <- LDA(DTM, K, method="Gibbs", control=list(iter = 500, verbose = 25))
```

```{r}
#investigating results
# have a look a some of the results (posterior distributions)
tmResult <- posterior(topicModel)
# format of the resulting object
attributes(tmResult)

nTerms(DTM) # lengthOfVocab

# topics are probability distributions over the entire vocabulary
beta <- tmResult$terms   # get beta from results
dim(beta)                # K distributions over nTerms(DTM) terms
rowSums(beta)            # rows in beta sum to 1
nDocs(DTM)               # size of collection

#for every document we have a probability distribution of its contained topics
theta <- tmResult$topics 
dim(theta)               # nDocs(DTM) distributions over K topics

#for every document we have a probability distribution of its contained topics
theta <- tmResult$topics 
dim(theta)               # nDocs(DTM) distributions over K topics

terms(topicModel, 10)
```

```{r}
# re-rank top topic terms for topic names - mkaing it relative 
topicNames <- apply(lda::top.topic.words(beta, 5, by.score = T), 2, paste, collapse = " ")
```

```{r}
attr(topicModel, "alpha")#messing with the alpha to see new topic distribution

topicModel2 <- LDA(DTM, K, method="Gibbs", control=list(iter = 500, verbose = 25, alpha = 2.5))

tmResult <- posterior(topicModel2)
theta <- tmResult$topics
beta <- tmResult$terms
topicNames <- apply(terms(topicModel2, 5), 2, paste, collapse = " ")  # reset topicnames
```

```{r}
# visualize topics as word cloud
topicToViz <- 1 # change for topic of interest
top40terms <- sort(tmResult$terms[topicToViz,], decreasing=TRUE)[1:40]
words <- names(top40terms)
# extract the probabilites of each of the 40 terms
probabilities <- sort(tmResult$terms[topicToViz,], decreasing=TRUE)[1:40]
# visualize the terms as wordcloud
mycolors <- brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
wordcloud(words, probabilities, random.order = FALSE, color = mycolors)
```

```{r}
#investigating individual documents (experiences)
exampleIds <- c(1, 50, 100)
lapply(corpus[exampleIds], as.character)
```

```{r}
#visualizing these three random documents' topic distributions
N <- length(exampleIds)
# get topic proportions form example documents
topicProportionExamples <- theta[exampleIds,]
colnames(topicProportionExamples) <- topicNames
vizDataFrame <- melt(cbind(data.frame(topicProportionExamples), document = factor(1:N)), variable.name = "topic", id.vars = "document")  
ggplot(data = vizDataFrame, aes(topic, value, fill = document), ylab = "proportion") + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +  
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ document, ncol = N)
```

```{r}
# What are the most probable topics in the entire collection?
topicProportions <- colSums(theta) / nDocs(DTM)  # mean probabilities over all paragraphs
names(topicProportions) <- topicNames     # assign the topic names we created before
sort(topicProportions, decreasing = TRUE) # show summed proportions in decreased order
```


```{r}
#plotting all 27 combinations of participant, section, and session
# Create a combined column for participant, session, and section
grouped_df <- grouped_df %>%
  mutate(combination = paste(id, session, section, sep = "_"))

# Get mean topic proportions per combination
topic_proportion_per_combination <- aggregate(theta, 
  by = list(combination = grouped_df$combination, section = grouped_df$section), 
  mean
)

# Set topic names
colnames(topic_proportion_per_combination)[3:(K + 2)] <- topicNames

# Reshape data frame
vizDataFrame <- melt(topic_proportion_per_combination, id.vars = c("combination", "section"))

# Split 'combination' into separate columns for 'id', 'session', and 'section'
vizDataFrame <- vizDataFrame %>%
  separate(combination, into = c("id", "session", "section"), sep = "_")

# Convert 'combination' back into a factor to order the bars
vizDataFrame$combination <- factor(
  paste(vizDataFrame$id, vizDataFrame$session, vizDataFrame$section, sep = "_"), 
  levels = c("1_1_before", "1_1_during", "1_1_after", 
             "1_2_before", "1_2_during", "1_2_after", 
             "1_3_before", "1_3_during", "1_3_after", 
             "2_1_before", "2_1_during", "2_1_after", 
             "2_2_before", "2_2_during", "2_2_after", 
             "2_3_before", "2_3_during", "2_3_after", 
             "3_1_before", "3_1_during", "3_1_after", 
             "3_2_before", "3_2_during", "3_2_after", 
             "3_3_before", "3_3_during", "3_3_after")
)

# Plot with the ordered combinations
ggplot(vizDataFrame, aes(x = combination, y = value, fill = variable)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  ylab("Proportion") + 
  xlab("Participant_Session_Section") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = paste0(alphabet(20), "FF"), name = "Topics") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))


```
```{r}
# Aggregate across participants by id, session, and section
agg_vizDataFrame <- vizDataFrame %>%
  group_by(session, section, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Combine session and section into a new variable for the x-axis
agg_vizDataFrame <- agg_vizDataFrame %>%
  mutate(combination = paste(session, section, sep = "_"))

agg_vizDataFrame$combination <- factor(
  paste(agg_vizDataFrame$session, agg_vizDataFrame$section, sep = "_"), 
  levels = c("1_before", "1_during", "1_after", 
             "2_before", "2_during", "2_after", 
             "3_before", "3_during", "3_after"))

# Create the plot with aggregated values
ggplot(agg_vizDataFrame, aes(x = combination, y = value, fill = variable)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + 
  ylab("Average Proportion") + 
  xlab("Session_Section") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = paste0(alphabet(20), "FF"), name = "Topics") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Aggregated Topic Proportions Across Participants by Session and Section")

```
```{r}
# Aggregate across sessions by participant, session, and section

  group_by(id, section, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

)

  ggtitle("Aggregated Topic Proportions Across Sessions by Participant and Section")
```
